newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Zeus to increase capital to 3 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Zeus to increase capital to 3 bln pesos.

text.p: Recently converted holding company Zeus Holdings Inc said on Friday its board had approved a plan to increase its authorised capital to three billion pesos from the present 100 million pesos.
Zeus was formerly a garment company which decided to dispose of all its assets and convert into a holding company.
A local cement company, Far East Cement, recently said it was interested in buying buy into Zeus.
A special stockholders' meeting has been set on October 21 to ratify the capital increase.
